fields.key: 連結 売上（前年同月比）
fields.name: 連結 売上（前年同月比）
fields.notes: The document provides '前年同期比' (year-on-year for the same period) instead of '前年同月比' (year-on-year for the same month), which is appropriate for a half-year report. The value is positive due to '増'.

fields.name: 連結 売上（百万円）
fields.notes: Value is extracted in thousand yen (千円). To get million yen (百万円), divide by 1000.
